description: The final cleaner's report of its comment cleanup: notes, the change and the pushed head

notes.description: What the cleanup changed or left and why, and what remains unconfirmed; empty when there is nothing to note

correction.description: Where this Step left the worktree HEAD. committed: at a new commit after the previous report's head, pushed to the pull request record's branch. no_change: still at that head, with nothing pushed

head.description: The worktree HEAD at the end of this Step, which, when committed, is the commit pushed to the pull request record's branch
